epic.name: App frame and sign-in
unverifiedAssumptions: The demo session is stored per browser tab (sessionStorage): opening the app in a new tab shows the sign-in screen again. Check this is fine for the demo.
IBM Plex fonts are downloaded once when the app is built, so the build machine needs internet access. Check this is acceptable where the app gets built.
A 404 such as 'File not found' is treated like any other service failure, with the persistent message and a Retry button. Check whether missing records should show a different, non-retry message.

The not-authorised message tells the user to 'contact your Genwood administrator and ask for access to the yield curve data service'. The docs name no contact or link. Check this wording, or supply a real contact.
The slow-loading and service-error wording ('Loading is taking longer than usual…', 'The data could not be loaded… Choose Retry to try again.') is a default. Confirm it suits the demo.
